tool.name: RADAR-PD Utility: Resolve SNS Input
tool.description: resolve and verify an SNS powder pattern and instrument profile before analysis
tool.command: touch '$pattern' '$instrument_profile' '$resolution_metadata' '$console_output' && trap "chmod a+r '$pattern' '$instrument_profile' '$resolution_metadata' '$console_output' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" EXIT && set -euo pipefail && resolve_args=(python /opt/radar-pd/scripts/ndip_runner.py resolve-ipts --bank '$source.bank' --pattern-output '$pattern' --instrument-output '$instrument_profile' --metadata-output '$resolution_metadata') && #if str($source.source_kind) == 'event_file' resolve_args+=(--event-file '$source.event_file') && #else resolve_args+=(--instrument '$source.instrument' --ipts '$source.ipts' --run '$source.run_number' --facility-root '$source.facility_root') && #end if "\${resolve_args[@]}" > >(tee -a '$console_output') 2> >(tee -a '$console_output' >&2)
tool.help: Resolve the exact reduced powder pattern and GSAS-II instrument profile available through the mounted SNS IPTS archive. Review the returned bank and provenance before submitting RADAR-PD Analyze. This utility performs no scientific analysis.
